Name: Vanilla Assets As Furniture
Author: sexynes
Description:
This mod adds over 600 vanilla assets as furniture. The dedicated catalogues can be purchased at Robin's Carpenter Shop. However, to access the dedicated catalogues, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]Misc Map Actions Properties - MMAP[/url] must be installed. Otherwise, the furniture can be accessed from the standard furniture catalogue.
